prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select visual companion style", "Choose Companion Sound Effects", "Select the vocalizations and sound cues your pet will make on your desktop.", "Playful Chimes", "Continue"]
1: ["Verifying desktop overlay integration and sound hardware status...", "Desktop Overlay Engine Initialized", "Audio Pipeline Ready"]
2: ["Select how you would like to create your desktop companion."]
3: ["Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Swipe through cards to learn desktop interaction shortcuts.", "Click pet to interact, right-click to hide or open settings"]
4: ["Ready to test your controls?", "Test Desktop Pet Controls", "Try hiding and summoning your pet right now before finishing setup.", "Test Summon Pet"]
5: ["Pick starter companion look", "Select Companion Starter Outfit", "Equip your new pet with a starter accessory before bringing them to your desktop.", "Classic Bow, Cozy Hat, Party Glasses"]
6: ["Sign In & Keep Your Pets Safe", "Signing in syncs your pet profiles, saved items, and desktop preferences safely to the cloud.", "Existing pet data is automatically restored upon sign-in."]
7: ["Choose your creation path after story context"]
8: ["Pet supports multi-monitor setups and auto-detects primary display boundary."]
9: ["Secure Your Companion Account", "Continue with Account", "Cloud Backup Protected"]
